name: Hikari Sentai Maskman
description:
Commander Sugata discovered the existence of the Royal Underground Empire Tube, a malignant force that desires to dominate the land, which is based underneath Japan.

He recruits five young people, each one specializing in a style of martial arts, and teaches them in the ways of the mystical "Aura Power" energy.

A year after he recruited and trained the Maskmen, Tube is ready to strike.

videos.title: DX Chogokin Great Five & Blow Up Turbo Ranger CM
DX Chogokin Galaxy Robo & Big Scale Turbo Ranger CM
DX Chogokin Galaxy Robo & Big Scale Turbo Ranger CM 2
The Mysterious, Beautiful Runaway
videos.overview: Five youths begin their battle against the underground forces of Tube as Maskman after they begin a war with the surface with the abduction of the mysterious Mio.

videos.title: Strange! The Dark Underground Castle
videos.overview: Takeru abandons Commander Sugata's Aura Power training when he receives a message from Mio about her survival and current whereabouts as Tube prepares to punish her.

videos.title: The First Step into the Unknown
videos.overview: As Emperor Zeba plunges the world into eternal darkness, the Maskman must complete their Aura Power training, even as Prince Igum decides to face Takeru for the shame Mio has brought him.

videos.title: Burn! F1 Spirits!
videos.overview: The Maskman must save a boy and his father trapped within a tunnel transformed by Oyoboo into an endless Medius tunnel.

videos.title: The Small Swordsman, Blue
videos.overview: Akira's teammates become frustrated with his childish behavior, and he tries to prove himself as Skull Doggler and Fumin start swapping people's faces.

videos.title: The God Hand of Dreams
videos.overview: While investigating a series of unusual earthquakes in Otaki, Takeru meets a boy who believes he possesses a legendary martial arts move.

videos.title: Explode! Kenta's Love
videos.overview: Kenta encounters a girl who likes him, inspiring Baraba to use a Doggler to sabotage his new love.

videos.title: Burn! The Flower's Sword
videos.overview: Igum uses a special flower to lure out Akira and Momoko to save their teammates after the other Maskman become frozen by a Doggler.

videos.title: Combine! Aura of Life
videos.overview: Takeru unexpectedly summons an alien child to Earth with his Aura, which interferes with Baraba's scheme to cut off the planet's electricity.

videos.title: Igam vs. Takeru
videos.overview: Igum challenges Takeru to his family's ceremonial Death Ring match, a cage showdown where only one of them will leave the battle alive!

videos.title: The Refugee From Underground
videos.overview: Kenta pursues a former ninja from underground who has abducted a crown associated with the truth behind Emperor Zeba.

videos.title: A Challenge! The Pride of a Shinobi
videos.overview: Haruka is forced to join in a showdown between Fumin and Oyoboo to defeat a ninja Doggler that can grant the ultimate shinobi power

videos.title: Chase the Idol!
videos.overview: Kenta investigates an idol with a reporter when he discovers she may be part of a plot to create a stronger army of Ungler Soldiers for Tube.

videos.title: The Great Escape to the Blue Sky!
videos.overview: Akira is dragged underground into a city where he meets children of Tube's empire who only dream of the surface and the sky.

videos.title: Farewell, Dear Flower!
videos.overview: A flower cared for by Momoko becomes the key to stopping a Doggler's deadly flower that kills as it sprouts.

videos.title: Deadly! Blazing Baraba
videos.overview: Kenta must fight alone against Baraba after the Tube general steals the Aura from his teammates to strengthen his powers.

videos.title: Smash it! The Hellish Labyrinth
videos.overview: Takeru is lured by Igum into a building transformed into a maze by a Doggler to confuse and wear him down.

videos.title: The Dear Bloodsucking Doll!
videos.overview: Haruka gives a doll she formerly owned to a girl who desires it, unknowing of the Doggler hiding within threatening to kill her.

videos.title: Apparition! Anagumas
videos.overview: Anagmas uses his magic to enhance the Tube forces while making Akira lose his memories during a sneak attack.

videos.title: A Trap! The Sinking Giant Robo
videos.overview: Momoko's pride as a kenpo teacher is tested by a powerful opponent set up by Anagmas as part of a scheme to defeat Maskman and Great Five.

videos.title: The Black Shadow of the Misty Valley
videos.overview: With Great Five buried underground, Sugata decides to investigate a rival mecha that has gained infamy for killing its creator.

videos.title: The Winds and Clouds of an Aura Storm!
videos.overview: With Galaxy Robo in their hands, the Maskman head forth to save Great Five, unknowing of the difficulties of doing so and an unknown key to fully activate their new mecha.

videos.title: Mio Who Has Become a Demon
videos.overview: A Doggler transforms a woman into a fake, evil Mio to lure Takeru into a Tube trap.

videos.title: The Grotto of the Boy Monster
videos.overview: The Maskman are summoned to Inasa where a boy is mutated into a monster by a Doggler as a city friend comes to visit.

videos.title: Akira's Lover!?
videos.overview: Akira enters a martial arts tournament unknowingly controlled by Tube due to a letter he has received from an unexpected writer.

videos.title: Lives That Disappeared on Hot Sand!
videos.overview: Kenta encounters a sorrowful girl who is actually a creature working to empower a Doggler while trying to preserve her own short life.

videos.title: Thief Knight Kiros!
videos.overview: Thief Knight Kiros, a lone wolf of the underground, takes on the Maskman in hopes of defeating them and winning Princess Iaul for himself.

videos.title: Mio is Princess Ial!?
videos.overview: An assault by Kiros draws Takeru away from research for Shot Bomber's replacement, where he finds out the truth about Mio and her current fate.

videos.title: The New Lethal Weapon of Friendship
videos.overview: The Maskman rush to face a Doggler while their new cannon remains incomplete against the warnings of their head engineer, who has personal ties with their enemy.

videos.title: Mama!! Baraba's Scream!
videos.overview: Akira decides to help Baraba's mother reach her son when he decides to partake in a trial to gain the legendary sword of the underground.

videos.title: It Appears! The Guardian Deity Igam Dragon
videos.overview: Igum attempts to gain the assistance of his family's guardian to increase his power, while Haruka has a crisis in the sudden loss of her own abilities.

videos.title: Oyobu's Lethal Dash
videos.overview: Kenta discovers a derelict car of a racing friend he decides to use to cheer him up, even while being chased by Oyoboo for accidentally obtaining a part of Baraba's latest plot.

videos.title: Takeru!! Severe their Love!
videos.overview: Takeru encounters an underground girl who wants to help him even though she has sworn her love to Kiros.

videos.title: The Love and Murderous Intentive Blues
videos.overview: A Doggler takes a human form in order to pursue love with Momoko, under the condition he destroys the Maskman in three days!

videos.title: The Mystery of Zeba! The Forbidden Tomb
videos.overview: Kiros opens a sealed tomb revealing a powerful Doggler that may be associated with Zeba's greatest secret.

videos.title: Elimination! The Destructive Twin Girls
videos.overview: Igum uses a Doggler to turn twin sisters into a combined menace as they destroy while trying to reunite with one another.

videos.title: Soldiers Who Bet on Their Dreams
videos.overview: Kiros uses a Doggler to remove Kenta's courage, forcing a boy he protected to help him rediscover his dreams to regain it.

videos.title: The Time to Erase Takeru
videos.overview: Igum devises a plan to go back in time and kill Takeru when he's little, thereby creating a time paradox. The Maskman must stop this plan, while getting to see how Takeru is like when he is a kid.

videos.title: Revival! The Mysterious X1 Mask
videos.overview: When a sixth Maskman saves the team from an attack, Takeru investigates to find out why he vanished from their battle with Tube.

videos.title: Resurrect! The Lovely Melody
videos.overview: A famous pianist returning to Japan is suddenly targeted by Tube due to a unknown connection with them and her mysterious benefactor.

videos.title: Female Thieves Haruka & Momoko
videos.overview: Kiros uses a Doggler to transform Haruka and Momoko into evil female thieves stealing wealth to give to Iaul.

videos.title: Fly! The Poem of a Timid Boy
videos.overview: A cowardly boy gains super-strength to defend himself after eating a cave mushroom Baraba wished to harvest for himself.

videos.title: Akira Loses His Eyesight! The Mysterious Spell
videos.overview: During a revenge attack by Kiros for stopping his previous research, Akira begins to hear a strange chant from underground that makes his eyes go blind.

videos.title: Transform! Underground Empire Swordsman Akira
videos.overview: The underground refugees complete a ritual in an attempt to awaken a great hero, but instead awaken a Doggler of the Igum clan who rewards its power to a surprising warrior...

videos.title: Prince Igam! You're a Woman!
videos.overview: The Maskman discover the truth behind why Akira was transformed into the Underground Knight Unas as they fight to get him back from Igum's control.

videos.title: Counterattack! The Bloody Pond's Secret
videos.overview: Igum's teacher guides her to a pond where Lethal Doggler was born to gain its power, only to learn a surprising revelation regarding what lies within.

videos.title: The Night Prior to the Attack! The Dance of Death
videos.overview: A dance student of Haruka is abducted to take part in Tube's ceremony to summon victory in their final war on the surface.

videos.title: Baraba! Death by Treachery
videos.overview: With no more chances left in Tube, Baraba joins with Kiros to abduct the frozen Iaul in a final chance to defeat Takeru.

videos.title: The Revived Princess Ial
videos.overview: With Kiros possessing Iaul's frozen body, Takeru and Igum both try to get her back in order to control her ultimate fate before the thief knight can thaw her out.

videos.title: Zeba! His Hair-Raising Secret Identity
videos.overview: Iaul and the Maskman obtain a ball that reveals the truth behind Emperor Zeba, even as he begins his final plan to raise the Underground Castle and cover the world in darkness.

videos.title: The Great Destruction of the Underground Empire Castle!
videos.overview: As Zeba finally unleashes eternal darkness upon the world, the Maskman must work with the twins of the Igum royal family and complete the restoration of light upon two realms.
